name: Lyon-Bron

runway.v: One runway, 16/34, 1,820 m x 45 m, paved.

customs.v: Customs on request only, 24 h notice: Mon-Fri, request ahead; for Sat, Sun and holidays ask before 17:00 on the last working day. Immigration through the PAF of Lyon Saint-Exupéry.
customs.quote: LUN - VEN : HX O/R PN 24 HR

handling.v: Handling mandatory for aircraft over 3.5 t MTOW.

fuel.v: UL Aero Super+, 100LL, Jet A1. Fuel 07:30-23:30 local (06:30-22:30 UTC winter).
fuel.quote: UL AERO SUPER+ - 100 LL - JET A1 (Total Energies et Air BP).

max_aircraft.v: Stands C/D12 take a wingspan up to 36 m.

notes: Read AIP France AD 2 LFLY, eAIP 06 Aug 2026 (older than the edition in force; the 29 Oct 2026 page could not be opened). The source states no night ban; operations outside ATS hours not confirmed. AIP times are UTC in winter, one hour earlier in summer.
